User wants to write a grants aim page on molecular subtypes and endometrial cancer.
The aim of the grant is to identify and characterize molecular subtypes of endometrial cancer and investigate their clinical and biological significance.

Endometrial cancer is a common gynecological malignancy, and its incidence is increasing worldwide. The proposed research aims to improve diagnosis and treatment by understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying endometrial cancer.
Endometrial cancer is a common gynecological malignancy in developed countries with increasing incidence worldwide.
Despite advances in surgical and radiation therapy, the survival rate for advanced stages of endometrial cancer remains poor.
The proposed research aims to identify molecular subtypes of endometrial cancer using genomic and transcriptomic approaches.
Objectives include identifying molecular subtypes, investigating their clinical significance, developing biomarkers for early detection and prognosis.
Comprehensive genomic and transcriptomic analysis will be performed using next-generation sequencing technologies to identify molecular subtypes of endometrial cancer.

User wants to know the difference between front-end and back-end web development.

Front-end development involves creating the user interface and designing the visual elements of a website or application, while back-end development refers to the server-side programming that powers the functionality of the website or application.
User thinks front-end developers make things look pretty while back-end developers make sure everything works smoothly.

While that's a good way to put it, front-end developers also need to ensure the user experience is intuitive and user-friendly, and back-end developers need to make sure the website or application is secure and scalable.
User asks if someone can be proficient in both front-end and back-end development.
Yes, it's possible for someone to be proficient in both front-end and back-end development, known as a full-stack developer.
User wants tips on becoming a full-stack developer.

Start with the basics of web development, learn a back-end programming language, build projects that incorporate both front-end and back-end development, stay up-to-date with new technologies, and join a community to network and learn from others.
User asks for recommendations on resources or online courses for learning front-end and back-end development.

Explainable AI (XAI) is a rapidly growing field, and medical image analysis is one of the areas where XAI is having a significant impact.
Attention mechanisms are being used to highlight the most relevant regions of an image that contribute to the model's predictions.
Gradient-based methods, such as Grad-CAM and Guided Backpropagation, are being used to visualize the gradients of the output class scores with respect to the input image.
Visualizations and heatmaps are being developed to illustrate the model's attention and feature importance.
Model interpretability techniques, such as LIME and SHAP values, are being applied to medical image analysis to provide model-agnostic explanations.
